recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Any remaining package availability or generated-content work should be tracked in the fhir-cross-version IG/package publication process or under a newer applied Jira issue that specifically changes the core package table or links.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core STU3 change request asking HL7 to document standard backport extension URLs and generate related extension information so IGs could reference elements from newer FHIR versions in older-version implementations, including STU3-to-DSTU2 and R4-to-R3/R2 scenarios.
initial_application: The request traces to GForge GF#13323 and was applied by 2018 commits 641002468f296d9085044e7704733e224a609f82 and 29cb644ee885b2c6959f2ab41d4b767391158b21, which added the source/versions.html cross-version extension section and linked the diff/transform pages to versions.html#extensions. The originating Zulip thread records Grahame pointing implementers to build.fhir.org/versions.html#extensions after that source change.
additional_context: Current source/versions.html is active through source/hierarchy.xml and now documents the cross-version URL pattern and hl7.fhir.uv.xver-* package matrix. Later applied issues such as FHIR-44614 and FHIR-42924 refined the same section. FHIR-46348 and FHIR-I minutes moved cross-version maps/artifacts out of the Extension Pack into the separate HL7 fhir-cross-version IG/repository; package publication/content completeness is therefore external to this core checkout.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current core source already satisfies the core documentation and package-pointer side of FHIR-16015, and adding duplicate text to source/extensibility.html would not materially improve implementer understanding.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied clarification tightened when cross-version extensions may be used instead of equivalent native elements.
Later Applied issue asked how to use cross-version extensions across multiple FHIR versions and concluded the necessary documentation changes had already been made.
Later Applied issue corrected the cross-version extension package table and added R6 coverage.
FHIR-extensions issue moved cross-version maps/artifacts out of the Extension Pack into their own cross-version repository/IG.
Related cross-version definition work remains Resolved - change required / MovingToGuide and is outside this default Applied/Published seed decision.
